units.title: Project the gradient when restricting to an affine subspace
units.statement: Let E be a real Hilbert space and K a complete linear subspace with inherited metric. If f has genuine ambient gradient g at a+u, then the affine restriction F_a(v)=f(a+v), v∈K, has genuine gradient P_K g at u.
assumptions: E is a complete real inner-product space; K is a complete real linear subspace with the inherited inner product. These assumptions generalize the finite-dimensional Euclidean source.
f:E→ℝ, a,g:E and u∈K. The genuine ambient gradient g exists at a+u: HasGradientAt f g (a+u). No totalized derivative is used as a regularity witness.
The restriction is the literal map F_a:K→ℝ, v↦f(a+v). Its gradient is a direction in K, not the affine point a+P_K g.

steps.title: Differentiate the affine parameterization
steps.text: For v in the direction space, the chart i_a(v)=a+v has derivative equal to the inclusion K↪E. The shift changes the evaluation point but contributes zero derivative.
steps.lean:
have hchart : HasFDerivAt (fun v : K => a + (v : E)) K.subtypeL u := by
    convert (hasFDerivAt_const a u).add K.subtypeL.hasFDerivAt using 1 <;>
      first | rfl | simp only [zero_add]
steps.detail: hchart: derivative of the constant plus the continuous linear inclusion.

steps.title: Apply the actual chain rule
steps.text: The ambient gradient represents Df(a+u). Composing with the chart derivative produces the restriction derivative for every v∈K; this derivative is proved rather than supplied.
steps.detail: hf.hasFDerivAt.comp u hchart; the Riesz functional is InnerProductSpace.toDual.

steps.title: Remove the normal component and identify the gradient
steps.text: The residual g−P_K g is perpendicular to K. Therefore all tangent pairings agree. With the inherited metric the projected vector represents exactly the restriction derivative, which proves the genuine gradient assertion and hence its uniqueness through the existing gradient API.
steps.lean:
have hdual : (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ E g).comp K.subtypeL =
      InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ K (K.orthogonalProjectionOnto g) := by
    ext v
    simp
  rw [hdual] at hcomp
  exact hasGradientAt_iff_hasFDerivAt.mpr hcomp

units.lean_statement: K is a subtype with its own inherited inner product. HasGradientAt includes genuine differentiability. The result is typed in K; a is a point shift, not part of the gradient. Completeness supplies the Riesz gradient and orthogonal projector.
units.lean_proof: Compose the genuine ambient derivative with the affine inclusion, then identify its Riesz functional using orthogonal projection. The typeclass conversion only reconciles equivalent submodule structures.
